# v2026.11.10

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.10.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.10.md).

This release covers **6 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- A client can bill to another customer (**Bill to**). The matcher, the Xero Import page and Send then use the payer's Xero contact. ([#515](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/515))
- A person can merge two contacts that are one client. Flow moves the jobs and invoices, and keeps the other name as an alias. ([#517](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/517))
- Contacts shows clients only. A contact that is not a client stays in Flow, hidden. ([#513](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/513))
- An owner or admin can release a wrong pair, so the Xero invoice and its job can pair again. ([#514](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/514))
- The Xero settings row shows how complete the copy is, and **Read again** reads the whole copy again. ([#516](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/516))

## Changes

- **Bill to** on a client's contact page names the payer, another Flow customer, one level only. ([#515](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/515))
- **Merge** on a contact's page (owner or admin). The merged contact stays, read only, and points at the kept one. ([#517](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/517))
- "Add Xero clients" adds only a contact that Xero marks a customer. ([#513](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/513))
- When a copy adds a new field, Flow reads that part of the copy again by itself. ([#516](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/516))

## Fixes

- After "Make Flow invoice" with a job, the job shows billed or paid at once. ([#513](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/513))
- A Xero invoice that was linked to a void Flow invoice can link to its own job again. ([#514](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/514))
